name: Gelato x Fat & Weird | 200mg Cookie | Cookie Anonymous
description: Introducing a first of its kind edible collab between Gelato Canna x Fat & Weird Cookie!! Our Cookie Anonymous flavor is enrobed in distillate infused chocolate and is made with a blue cookie dough base, Biscoff frosting core, with chips ahoy, biscoff cookies, Oreos, cookie dough bites mixins.
